\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Norms}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Products.Norms
\section{Overview}
Finite weighted moment norms satisfy Hölder duality, tail estimates, and estimates for influences and omitted low degree components. The weights in these statements need not form probability distributions.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Signed power dual witness]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.signed_power_dual}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
For every $q>1$ and $z\in\mathbb R$, set $g=z|z|^{q-2}$. Then $zg=|z|^q$ and $|g|^{q/(q-1)}=|z|^q$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted Hölder inequality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_holder}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$, and let $p,q>1$ satisfy $1/p+1/q=1$. For $f,g:I\to\mathbb R$, $\sum_iw_if_ig_i\le(\sum_iw_i|f_i|^p)^{1/p}(\sum_iw_i|g_i|^q)^{1/q}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted norm duality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.norm_le_of_pairing}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.signed_power_dual}
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$, $q>1$, $z:I\to\mathbb R$, and $N\ge0$. If $\sum_iw_iz_ig_i\le N(\sum_iw_i|g_i|^{q/(q-1)})^{(q-1)/q}$ for every $g:I\to\mathbb R$, then $(\sum_iw_i|z_i|^q)^{1/q}\le N$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Self-adjoint contraction duality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.selfAdjoint_contraction}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.norm_le_of_pairing, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_holder}
\difficulty{4}
Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$ and define $\|f\|_{r,w}=(\sum_iw_i|f_i|^r)^{1/r}$. If an operator $T$ satisfies $\sum_iw_i(Tf)_ig_i=\sum_iw_if_i(Tg)_i$ for all $f,g$ and $\|Tg\|_{q/(q-1),w}\le\|g\|_{q/(q-1),w}$ for every $g$, where $q>1$, then $\|Tf\|_{q,w}\le\|f\|_{q,w}$ for every $f$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Weighted moment tail bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_tail_le_norm_div_rpow}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$, $f:I\to\mathbb R$, and $q,c>0$. Then $\sum_{i:c\le|f_i|}w_i\le((\sum_iw_i|f_i|^q)^{1/q}/c)^q$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Centered absolute moment estimate]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.centered_abs_sum_sq_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$ and let $g:I\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $\sum_iw_ig_i=0$. Then $(\sum_iw_i|g_i|)^2\le4(\sum_iw_ig_i^2)(\sum_{i:g_i>0}w_i)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted exponential mean]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_rpow_mean_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$ with $\sum_iw_i>0$, let $d_i\in\mathbb R$, and let $\rho>0$. Then $(\sum_iw_i)\rho^{(\sum_iw_id_i)/(\sum_iw_i)}\le\sum_iw_i\rho^{d_i}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Large term from three-halves moment]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.exists_sq_div_sum_le_of_sum_three_halves}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be finite and let $a_i\ge0$ have positive sum. If $A\ge0$ and $A\le\sum_i a_i^{3/2}$, then some $i\in I$ satisfies $(A/\sum_ja_j)^2\le a_i$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted low degree omission]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_lowDegree_omission_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $\alpha$ be finite, let $E(S)\ge0$ for every $S\subseteq\alpha$, let $J\subseteq\alpha$, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $\rho^k\sum_{|S|\le k,\ S\nsubseteq J}E(S)\le\sum_{i\notin J}\sum_{S\ni i}\rho^{|S|}E(S)$.
\end{theorem}
